newsitem.title: USA: Canada spot natgas rises amid cold East, low stocks.
newsitem.headline: Canada spot natgas rises amid cold East, low stocks.

text.p: Canadian natural gas prices bounced higher Thursday as colder weather moved into the East and low storage supplies in the West continued to keep buyers in the spot market, market sources said.
At the AECO storage hub, prices gained four cents to about C$1.82-1.83 per gigajoule (GJ) despite today's forecasts in Calgary calling for a temperature high of 16 degrees Celsius.

"People are starting to get worried. They're nowhere near where they have to be for injections," one Calgary-based trader said, noting 160 million cubic feet per day of gas was injected into storage on Wednesday.
